_readme: Relevance smoke fixture for the search-parity gate (T4-2). Each entry pairs an unambiguous query (an exact title/artist string, or its Korean rendering, from the committed corpus) with the expected canonical record id. The gate asserts expectId appears in the TOP 3 results of BOTH the client MiniSearch path and the worker SQLite path. These are curated from real corpus records (verified, not guessed) so a ranking regression that buries an obvious match fails loudly on whichever path regressed. Consumed by search-parity.golden.test.ts; independent of the divergence snapshot.
